summary: Fixes the automation engine after review: a node's effects roll back when its output is too large, foreach keeps large integers exact, wait deadlines count from after the subject lock, run history releases its connection before projecting and hides filter_error reasons from viewers without the fields, cron with CRON_TZ=/TZ= or not five fields is refused instead of panicking, Enable locks the connections it uses and connectors Store.Delete checks uses inside its transaction through the new optional connectors.TxUsageIndex (the engine UsageIndex implements it), so the two never wait on each other for pool connections, manual starts and restarts resolve run-as under the graph lock, Restart drops retained input values whose own provenance has no access rule left, the queue recovery scan skips busy subjects, queued cancellation takes the subject lock first and changes the queue row before the run row, as promotion and Disable do, a restart that cannot run no longer supersedes its predecessor, SaveVersion/Enable/Disable answer with the state they committed, schedule activation is taken after the graph lock, and retention uses one cutoff and never cascades to kept steps.
